question: Separate total-rate confounding, noisy-slot dilution and finite typed-readout access before adding content losses.
missing_old_refit_completion: One 500-step refit of saved and hash-verified exact seed449 synthetic replay; old partial receipt stays unchanged.
optimizer: Adam lr=.003, batch32, fixed last step; no clipping or validation selection
data: Reuse exact original XOR train/test schedules for attribution, not independent confirmation; each modality gets only its own privileged planted bit, common gets true S.
paired_controls: Same data, batches and explicit noise; same survival head and role-offset initialization. Phi shapes differ; phi initialization cannot be paired tensorwise.
role_bank: Fixed one-hot role tensor product then sum; algebraically role-indexed concatenation, no patient-dependent attention/weight/selection. Requires paired value-role permutation and stable roles; not semantic identity or a novel contribution.
rate_units: Gaussian rate nats per modality summed over all slots. Single_total1 = one slot x1; repeated_total1 = four slots x.25; repeated_total4 = four slots x1. Deterministic clean code has no finite rate claim.
known_math: For code amplitude^2=1-exp(-2c), variance=exp(-2c), KL=c and raw repeated-bit Gaussian SNR=K*(exp(2C/K)-1) <= exp(2C)-1 for fixed total C. This concerns privileged scalar Gaussian codes, not arbitrary neural pooling.
evaluation: Five paired noise draws scored as separate censored-survival NLL values, then averaged; proper survival-distribution Bayes mixture. Fixed-head perturbations retained from previous receipt.
outputs: Fresh ignored local_evidence directory; public aggregate receipt only, no synthetic arrays or weights committed.
